newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gold to straddle $340, downside favoured.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gold to straddle $340, downside favoured.

text.p: SPOT NY CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
-----------------VIEWS FROM THE MARKET - June 20 -------------
Good bullion is expected to trade quietly on Friday, and largely straddle the $340 level, although the downside is favoured with sentiment negative, analysts said.
Silver will also be quiet, but may move down if moving-average support is broken around $4.75.
GOLD -
Business is expected to be quiet - at least through the European part of the day - with the market to-ing and fro-ing narrowly either side of $340, just above Thursday's one-year lows.
"I think it will remain at this level, with a slightly firmer tone coming from good physical demand," a European analyst said.
But there is little real upside potential, with fundamental sentiment largely negative after recent news Belgium would like to cut its gold reserves by issuing coins.
"Really, the central banks are looking for ways to reduce their gold holdings," the analyst said.
At 0757 GMT spot gold was quoted at $339.95/340.25, down slightly from Thursday's close of $340.10/340.30.
PGMs
Most interest and activity is likely to seen in the platinum group metals (PGMs) on Friday, with the market nervous over whether Russia will resume exports of these metals today.
"The action is still in platinum and palladium, and it is difficult to judge what they will do," the analyst said.
At 0757 GMT spot platinum was quoted at $413.00/418.00, against a $414.70/415.70 close yesterday.
SILVER -
A dull day is in prospect, although prices could swing lower if $4.75 is broken on the downside, as this level represents both 10-day and 30-day moving average support, analysts said.
At 0757 GMT spot silver was quoted at $4.75/4.77, down two cents.
--Martin Hayes, London Newsroom 44 171 542 8080
